name: Edgerton (United States)
description: White field with a green vertical stripe at the hoist, charged with the city logo: a stylised orange letter E of six blocks, the lower hoist block green with a script e for the city's place in Johnson County.
history: Edgerton is a city in Johnson County, Kansas. According to the city's 2016 State of the City report quoted on Flags of the World, the green box in the lower corner of the stylised E represents Edgerton's location within Johnson County.
